en: The Ritual Manual for Recitation of the Method of Peerless Efficacy through the Great Spiritual Power of Bodhisattva Aśvaghoṣa,
translated by Vajrajñāna by Imperial Decree.
In the past, when the Tathāgata Śākyamuni was seated beneath the Bodhi tree amidst a great assembly,
the Bodhisattva Aśvaghoṣa came forward and addressed the Buddha, saying,
"I wish to speak of my adornment of the Buddha-dharma."
Furthermore, for the sake of providing clothing to sentient beings who are impoverished, lowly, and naked at the end of the eon,
he practiced the bodhisattva path throughout incalculable kalpas.
The great divine mantra he thereby obtained possesses immense majestic power.
His physical strength and power are peerless;
he is able to perform extraordinary deeds within the world,
and nothing can obstruct or hinder him.
At that time, the Buddha slightly smiled and addressed the Bodhisattva Aśvaghoṣa, saying:
"Excellent, great man!
You should speak; you should speak quickly."
"So be it, World-Honored One; out of compassion for me, please listen.
With palms joined in joy, he emitted great radiance from his mouth and spoke this divine mantra within the light:
Namo samanta-maitrāyaṇāya kākamukha-criṭa-ra-khaṭa-ra-kha svāhā. If one wishes to receive and uphold this dharma:
First, one should exhaust all wealth and profit to provide offerings and support for the master,
receive and practice the mudrās and mantras,
and then paint an image of a bodhisattva.
His physical appearance is the color of white flesh; he sits with palms joined upon a white lotus flower,
riding a white horse and wearing white garments,
his body adorned with jeweled necklaces.
Wearing a flower crown upon his head and with his right foot extended downward,
he completed the painted image and the earthen altar,
beginning on the third day of the third month.
The image faces east and one makes offerings toward it facing west,
using various vast offering implements such as ghee, milk, and ghee lamps,
for twenty-eight days up to a hundred days.
One must be pure and clean.
The kindness of the bhikṣus and the masters who transmit the Dharma and benefit sentient beings must not be lost or neglected.
I constantly emit great radiance upon the houses of my donors and throughout the lands.
He will achieve wealth such as brocades, silks, cotton, and fine fabrics;
his accumulation of gold and jewels will be like a mountain range,
providing for the enjoyment of the world.
If there is a single person in a single country who practices my original vow,
then all the households of the people throughout the heavens and across the land shall be exactly as previously described.
May they achieve the adornment of wealth and profit;
may not a single person lack anything or suffer from affliction.
By my original vow, I shall provide all manner of adornments and treasures for them.
Regarding those phenomena toward which one’s mind has reached doubt,
one gives rise to thoughts of lack of faith; because of this,
one does not accomplish the aspirations of even a single lifetime.
The fruits of future lives are not fixed;
one should, with a steadfast heart, devote oneself to the Dharma rather than begrudging the virtue of its transmission.
I shall certainly protect and keep you in mind day by day and at all times,
fulfilling the wealth of the world’s supreme, wondrous bliss and prosperity,
just as previously stated, by remaining mindful of my fundamental vow.
Facing the precious altar,
perform the mudrā and recite the mantra while bending the left middle finger and ring finger.
Press the two fingernails with the thumbs,
extend the index fingers and little fingers, and place them upon the heart;
hold the rosary in the right hand and recite the mantra.
This is called the "Jade Ring Seal that Accomplishes All Wishes.
This mudrā-seal is not to be recorded in writing for the deluded practitioners of the final age;
it shall be selected from ten out of every ten thousand people.
From among ten people, one was selected;
this was permitted. Thus, the ritual procedure for the successful cultivation of silkworms was established.
